definitions.explanation: The process of getting better from an illness or injury. Almost always used in the fixed expression {快方|かいほう}に{向|む}かう (to head toward recovery).

examples.japanese: {病気|びょうき}が{快方|かいほう}に{向|む}かっている。
{手術後|しゅじゅつご}、{順調|じゅんちょう}に{快方|かいほう}に{向|む}かっている。
examples.english: After the surgery, recovery is progressing smoothly.

examples.japanese: {入院|にゅういん}していた{祖父|そふ}が{快方|かいほう}に{向|む}かっていると{聞|き}いて、{安心|あんしん}した。
examples.english: I was relieved to hear that my grandfather, who was hospitalized, is recovering.

notes:
USAGE:
Almost exclusively used in the expression {快方|かいほう}に{向|む}かう (to head toward recovery). Rarely appears in other constructions. A somewhat formal word, often used in medical or news contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {快方|かいほう}に{向|む}かう (to be recovering)
- {快方|かいほう}に{向|む}かっている (is recovering)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {回復|かいふく}: recovery — more widely used and versatile, applies to health, economy, data, etc.
- {全快|ぜんかい}: complete recovery — emphasizes being fully healed
